prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original grounded medieval RPG LOW RES PIXEL ART location review concept, elevated three-quarter cutaway. Chunky hard square pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained three-tone stone timber linen iron, muted earth palette, no smooth painting or photorealism. No people, no readable text, no quest UI, no magic, no claimed outcome. Modest practical scale, no giant fantasy architecture. Open ordinary return path clearly visible. Geometry is a proposal, not certified collision or inventory. One small open vineyard hillside lease discussion pavilion by a surviving vine row and a sparse failed vine row. Two separate small shelves each hold ONE plain grafting knife, one for each household; separate modest seasonal tally sticks sit on central table, no signed contract or coins. Vineyard path continues freely outside pavilion down to village, no gate controlling farm access. No grapes harvested, transplanted vines, triumphant full harvest, permanent land purchase or agreement. Focus finite one-season discussion objects and separate tool ownership.
